# External dependencies of Fugu. scripts/deps installs each line.
# The secret gate of make check runs gitleaks, so the tool environment
# installs it before every other environment.
tool bin gitleaks https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_{os}_{arch}.tar.gz gitleaks

test pkg libssh2
test pkg signify-osx
test cpan Perl::Critic
test cpan Perl::Tidy
test cpan Net::SSH2
test cpan URI

develop cpan HTTP::Daemon
develop cpan HTTP::Message
develop cpan LWP::UserAgent
